title: ews-nf pipeline parameters
description: A workflow for analyzing Ewing sarcoma single-cell RNA-sequencing samples.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

scpca_nf_dir.description: Path to directory containing output files from running scpca-nf

sample_ids.description: List of sample IDs to process, must match the folder names in scpca_nf_dir

containers.title: Containers
containers.description: Locations for Docker images used by workflow processes

cell_type_ewing_container.description: Container to use for running individual modules
